best.rule: Decide for each UN Sustainable Development Goal whether this work substantively contributes to or studies it. The goal need not be named: count applied work whose topic or stated purpose directly serves it (crop protection, antiviral compounds, energy efficiency, greener solvents, migrants' rights). Conceptual, metaphorical or incidental mentions, and generic innovation claims, do not. Most works contribute to no goal.
best.sdg2: SDG 2 Zero hunger: hunger, food insecurity, malnutrition, diet and nutrition status or its measurement, monitoring and survey data, food supply, sustainable agriculture, smallholder farming. Veterinary or animal-health work (parasite infection, feeding behaviour, feed conversion, herbivore self-medication) does not count. Counts only if it substantively contributes to or studies the goal; passing mention is not contributing; most works contribute to no goal.
best.sdg4: SDG 4 Quality education: substantive work on access to, quality or outcomes of education, training and lifelong learning, including schooling, teachers, curricula and education policy; also literacy in any form (reading, health, digital, computer, financial), adult or older-learner courses, and educational attainment gaps by gender or marginalisation. Passing mention is not contributing; most works contribute to no goal.
best.sdg8: SDG 8 Decent work and economic growth
best.sdg9: SDG 9 Industry, innovation and infrastructure: resilient infrastructure (transport, energy, water, ICT networks), inclusive sustainable industrialisation, industry-sector development, practices and upgrading (including service industries such as tourism and hospitality), research, innovation, technology adoption, small-firm access to finance. Counts only if the work substantively contributes to or studies this; passing mention is not contributing; most works contribute to no goal.
best.sdg12: SDG 12 Responsible consumption and production: sustainable use of resources, waste reduction and recycling, sustainable production and consumption patterns
best.sdg15: SDG 15 Life on land: terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems, forests, rangelands, soils and land degradation, desertification, biodiversity, wildlife, plants and their ecology, habitat loss or fragmentation, invasive species, restoration, revegetation, conservation and protected areas. Studies of plant or ecosystem ecology, including reviews and methods for such evidence, count; a passing mention does not. Most works contribute to no goal.
best.sdg16: SDG 16 Peace, justice and strong institutions: peace, reducing violence and crime, rule of law and access to justice, accountable institutions, corruption
best.sdg17: SDG 17 Partnerships for the goals: international cooperation, development finance and aid, technology transfer and trade for sustainable development
